BOOK ONLINE Our Services Medical Aesthetics & Wellness Center - Med Spa in Newton, MA Newton Medical Aesthetics & Metabolic Wellness Services Nancy Landry, RN At Newton Beauty, Nancy Landry, RN, helps clients look and feel their best through Botox treatments, aesthetic services, and wellness support focused on natural-looking results, improved skin health, and overall wellness. Services provided by Nancy Landry, RN, include Botox injections , medical-grade skin peels, skin rejuvenation, IV vitamin therapy , lip treatments , and personalized wellness infusions designed to hydrate, restore, and revitalize from the inside out. Additional services offered within Newton Beauty, including dermal fillers and metabolic treatments, are provided independently on-site by a licensed medical provider operating her own separate practice within Newton Beauty. A Practice with a Trusted Reputation Although newer, Newton Beauty has quickly earned trust in the Newton community by prioritizing client care, safety, and results. Safety, Quality & Natural Results We use high-quality products and follow strict safety protocols. Client comfort, confidence, and satisfaction are our top priorities. Personalized Aesthetic Care Backed by Medical Expertise Led by an Experienced Registered Nurse Nancy Landry, RN, brings over 25 years of clinical experience and compassion to every treatment. She specializes in Botox and skin rejuvenation, medical-grade peels , vitamin injections , and IV wellness therapy . By combining clinical expertise with an aesthetic eye, she delivers natural, refreshed results with medical safety at the core. Newton Beauty is a wellness-focused space where independent licensed providers operate their own medical practices. Elizandra “Ellie” Adams, APRN, FNP-BC, a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner specializing in medical aesthetics, metabolic wellness , and hormone balance , operates independently within the space. Ellie provides the following services through her own medical practrice: dermal fillers , biostimulators (including Sculptra ), hormone therapy , and medical weight management. All clinical care, treatment planning, and medical decision-making are solely the responsibility of the indepent provider. Advanced Metabolic, Hormone & Weight Management Care with Ellie Adams, APRN Metabolic, hormone, and weight management services are offered on-site through Elizandra “Ellie” Adams, APRN, FNP-BC, who is a Clinical Member of the Obesity Medicine Association. Ellie provides evidence-based hormone therapy (HRT), peptide therapy , and a signature Weight Loss Advantage Membership . Her approach focuses on addressing the root causes of metabolic changes to support sustainable health, energy, and wellness.
